newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Dorm sees 1997 issuance at about $3.6 bln.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Dorm sees 1997 issuance at about $3.6 bln.

text.p: The New York State Dormitory Authority said Tuesday it expects to issue around the same amount of debt in 1997 that it plans to sell in 1996, or about $3.6 billion.
Cheryl Ishmael, deputy executive director, said, "We expect the 1997 calendar to continue at that same heavy pace."

Ishmael, speaking at an industry conference sponsored by the Bond Buyer, added that the Dormitory Authority expects to implement an interest rate swap of around $250 million as part of an effort to use more innovative financing techniques.
For example, this year the authority sold its first overseas debt of around $75 million to investors in Europe and Asia.
